items.title: USA Rare Earth Announces Leadership Transition
items.summary: USA Rare Earth announced a leadership transition with Barbara Humpton retiring as CEO on October 1, 2026, to be succeeded by Thras Moraitis, current CEO of Serra Verde Group. Michael Blitzer was elected Executive Chairman effective immediately. The changes follow the anticipated completion of USAR's combination with Serra Verde by end of August 2026, positioning the company to create the first fully integrated Western mine-to-magnet rare earth supply chain.
